<!-- Shared language include; defines Lang, translations, language state, and _lang.
Quarto expands shortcodes inside comments, so the include syntax is omitted here. -->

```{=html}
<script src="/components/langSwitcher.js"></script>
```

```{ojs}
import { lang as Lang } from "/helpers/lang.js"

general_translations = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/generalTranslations.json").json()

languages = [
  { key: "en", label: "English", locale: "en-US" },
  { key: "fr", label: "Français", locale: "fr-FR" },
]

// Language state lives in the navbar switcher; this cell just subscribes.
langKey = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  notify(window.atlasLang ?? "en");
  const onChange = (e) => notify(e.detail);
  window.addEventListener("atlas:lang", onChange);
  return () => window.removeEventListener("atlas:lang", onChange);
})

language = languages.find((l) => l.key === langKey) ?? languages[0]

_lang = Lang.lg(language.key)
```
